'''''Thor''''' was a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] that served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It fought at the [[Battle of the Tungra sector]]. Its primary role was to resupply [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] with [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] whenever they ran out.
